attr.title: Dark Ember
attr.desc: Dark Ember is a pixel-art bonfire-defense roguelike. Pull the sword from the last bonfire, gather resources in the light, build defences, and survive endless waves of dark creatures across procedural biomes.
attr.inst: Download the game files (DarkEmber-v0.1.22-windows.zip) from https://kindlegames.itch.io/dark-ember. Extract the zip and copy the DarkEmber.exe file into the ports/darkember/gamedata/ folder on your device.
